title: Monthly roadmap sync: operational bridge and decision heatmap
creator: Diego Ramirez
description: Run the March monthly roadmap sync and produce an operational 'bridge' document + decision heatmap for execs and EngOps. Purpose: surface changes to initiative timing, highlight risk lanes that affect Dedicated capacity and runtime optimization investments, and capture concrete escalation lanes for SRE/infra. Deliverables: 1) 2-page bridge doc mapping OKR progress to delivery lanes, 2) Decision heatmap with recommended go/no-go items and trade-offs, 3) Action tracker with owners and dates, 4) Updated slide deck for the exec readout and a short recording for async stakeholders.
background: Previous readouts surfaced ambiguity between Optimize backlog and runtime kernel work (affects inference unit economics). Several initiatives shifted in Q1; execs requested a tighter operational bridge to avoid month-to-month misalignment. This ticket consolidates inputs from Eng, Console PM, and Design to produce a concise artifact that supports decision-making and escalation.
decisions: Recommend delaying non-critical KV-cache refactor by one sprint to prioritize batching improvements tied to runway cost savings
Approve incremental canary for runtime-1.22 on Dedicated for 2 clusters before large scale rollout
Defer Private deployment UI polish to next cycle; provide temporary guidance in Console docs
tradeoffs: Batching vs latency: enabling more aggressive batching reduces unit cost but increases p95 for short requests; recommended profile: user-facing chat routes keep stricter latency SLOs, background embedding/async routes accept larger batch sizes.
KV cache refactor timeline: full refactor yields 8-12% cost savings but carries risk of cache invalidation regressions; alternative is targeted hot-prefix caching for immediate wins
